Method of Attack: Account Takeover via social engineering strategy
Attack Vector: The attacker took over an NPM account of one of the project maintainers and published multiple new versions of the package injected with malicious code that drains the wallets of users.
Indicators of Compromise: Discrepancy in package versions between the package manager (npm) and the version control system (Git). The versions released on npm lacked matching tags on Git. This mismatch serves as an indicator of suspicious activity.
